items.t: Engine oil sludge (oil gel)
items.job: Replace engine with a used or rebuilt unit
items.note: Mild cases may be helped by an engine flush and short oil change intervals. Toyota sludge coverage has expired.

items.t: Brake booster hose can freeze in severe cold (recall)
items.job: Replace brake booster vacuum hose
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Theft-deterrent wiring connector faults (recall)
items.job: Repair theft-deterrent wiring connector
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Steering lock bar can crack and lock the wheel (recall)
items.job: Replace steering lock assembly
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Airbag control module may fail (recall)
items.job: Replace airbag control module
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Crankshaft pulley can let the power steering belt come off (recall)
items.job: Replace crankshaft pulley and belt
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: VVT oil line can burst
items.job: Replace rubber VVT oil line with the all-metal line
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the engine ran low on oil. Toyota once covered this; ask the dealer.

items.t: Water pump leaks
items.job: Replace water pump and coolant
items.note: No parts-plus-labor source found, so this is based on estimator totals: RepairPal 2008 Avalon $605–$752; YourMechanic 2005–2018 3.5L V6 $760–$889 (shop/dealer $864–$1,371). Many shops replace the thermostat and drive belt at the same time.

items.t: Accelerator pedal can stick (recalls)
items.job: Modify or replace accelerator pedal assembly
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Left front lower control arm can separate (recall)
items.job: Replace left front lower control arm and align
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag sensing may be off (recalls)
items.job: Recalibrate or replace passenger seat occupant sensor
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Airbag computer may switch off airbags at startup (recall)
items.job: Reprogram or replace airbag computer
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Misfire codes and check engine light
items.job: Replace failed ignition coil (and spark plugs if due)
items.note: Parts: one coil 90919-A2013 ($94–$133) up to one coil plus six plugs 90919-01263. Hours from KBB dealer labor for the 2019 plug job ($285–$322). KBB 2019 spark plug job: $402–$540 total. Rear plugs need the intake removed.

items.t: Torque converter lock-up fault with check engine light
items.job: Update engine and transmission software
items.note: Toyota bulletin T-SB-0122-20: reprogram the engine/transmission computer, 0.7 flat-rate hours. Often covered by the federal emissions warranty (8 years/80,000 miles). If the torque converter must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Knocking from the brake vacuum pump at idle
items.job: Replace brake vacuum pump
items.note: Toyota bulletin T-SB-0115-22 covers the 2019–2022 Avalon: replace the vacuum pump, 1.8 flat-rate hours (2.3 in the earlier T-SB-0316-17). OEM pump $430 sale / $641 list. Covered by the 3-year/36,000-mile basic warranty when new.

items.t: Front shock absorber noise over bumps
items.job: Replace both front struts and align
items.note: Price covers both sides. Sometimes only the strut mounts need replacing.

items.t: Airbag-related recalls (steering column and passenger sensor)
items.job: Inspect and repair steering column airbag parts or seat sensor
items.note: Covered by a Toyota recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Spare tire may be under-inflated from the factory (recall)
items.job: Inspect and set spare tire pressure
items.note: Free under recall 17V-295. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Replacement seat belt buckle can fool the airbag system (recall 18V-569)
items.job: Test and replace inner seat belt assembly
items.note: Free under recall 18V-569. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Oil seeping from the lower oil pan seam
items.job: Reseal lower oil pan
items.note: Pan must be cleaned and resealed; the subframe is often lowered to reach the bolts.

items.t: Check engine light on the 2.5L four-cylinder
items.job: Diagnose stored engine fault codes
items.note: Diagnosis only; the part needed depends on which code is stored.

items.t: Rear axle may be too weak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear axle hub assemblies
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front subframe welds may fail (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front subframe if needed
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Steering shaft joint may not be welded (recall)
items.job: Inspect weld and replace steering column assembly
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Airbag inflators may not fully inflate (recall)
items.job: Replace affected airbag
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Brake master cylinder seal can leak (recall)
items.job: Replace rear brake master cylinder seal
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Seat heater wiring can short and burn (recall)
items.job: Disconnect affected accessory seat heaters
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Trunk subwoofer can short and overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace audio amplifier and add subwoofer cover
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: A/C water can drip onto the airbag computer (recall)
items.job: Seal A/C housing and cover airbag control module
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Airbag control unit may fail in a crash (recall)
items.job: Inspect airbag computer and add noise filter
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.job: Replace windshield wiper switch
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Pre-collision system can brake for no reason (recall)
items.job: Replace pre-collision system parts
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel delivery pipe can leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel delivery pipe
items.note: Free at a Toyota dealer under the recall. Check your VIN first.
